issues.title: [F0-01] Prepare fork issue tracking and upstream baseline
issues.body:
<!-- ludo-windows:F0-01 -->
## Outcome

Enable Issues in bayramog/ludo; create one tracking epic and six milestones. Preserve fork commits while integrating upstream beta.33 on a separate baseline branch. Keep upstream free of planning posts.

## Scope and architecture

Windows 11 x64; shared UI/backend/engine and shell adapters. Preserve Linux desktop and Decky. No native Windows game/storefront integration. No new background lifetime policy before F0-03.

## Dependencies

None; program entry point.

## Acceptance evidence

- [ ] Issue links, milestone assignments and dependency graph are read back from GitHub.
- [ ] Record the exact fork and upstream SHAs, merge ancestry and baseline failures.
- [ ] Publish the support policy and contribution/release requirements; do not mark runtime support complete.

## Implementation and verification

One scoped branch and fork PR. Follow upstream CONTRIBUTING.md: Conventional Commits, shared shell contracts, documented artifact generation and real built-UI tests when UI changes. Attach exact commit, OS/runtime/emulator versions, automated results and live evidence. Record known failures and unsupported native features explicitly. Code merged alone is not completion. For data writes, demonstrate backup, failed-write recovery and migration/rollback.

## Sources

- [Upstream contribution guide](https://github.com/rommapp/ludo/blob/0172458/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Upstream release contract](https://github.com/rommapp/ludo/blob/0172458/RELEASING.md)
- [Pinned RetroBat 8.3.1 manifest](https://github.com/RetroBat-Official/retrobat/blob/8.3.1/system/templates/emulationstation/es_systems.cfg)

Research snapshot: 2026-11-15. Native capabilities and RomM mappings remain unverified until evidenced.

F0-04, F3-01

- c64

- [ ] Verify effective save/state directories, core/content overrides, region/member identity and special containers.
- [ ] Record real Windows and compatible Linux transfer evidence, or explicit version/format incompatibility.
- [ ] A native missing feature requires authoritative proof; unimplemented/unverified support cannot be closed as N/A.
